recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with curly hair looking to the side, set against a heavily distressed, multi-colored textured wall. The composition features a bold, horizontal typographic band across the center with a secondary script element below.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated with background through texture overlays
Horizontal text band bisecting the subject's torso
Contrast between cool blue tones and warm yellow/orange accents
Balance between the subject on the left and negative space on the right
coreInvariants: Heavy grunge/plaster texture across the entire frame
Desaturated skin tones with high-contrast shadows
A central horizontal band of color behind the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject positioned on the left third, facing right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, dark blue display text spanning the center width.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the right, then drops to the central text and secondary script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant textured space on the right side of the frame to balance the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal and slate blue in the clothing and background shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale yellow in the background highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow for the script text and warm orange rust tones in the background corners.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low to medium saturation, giving a weathered, vintage feel.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Extra-bold, rounded geometric sans with thick strokes.
Secondary text: Fluid, slanted cursive with high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary text features a subtle inner glow or gradient to separate it from the background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif for impact paired with a light, airy script for personality.
graphicDevices: Horizontal color wash band behind text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, thick geometric structure of the display text.
Provides the necessary casual, cursive contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with curly hair in a grey hoodie, looking profile-right. The background should be a heavily distressed wall with layers of peeling paint in teal, white, and yellow. Apply a global grunge texture and a horizontal color-wash band across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, rounded geometric sans-serif name in dark teal across the center. Below it, right-aligned, add a yellow script title with a slight drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Texture is visible over the subject's clothes
Text is legible against the busy background
Color palette maintains a sun-drenched, vintage feel

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any unique logos or branding marks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture doesn't obscure the subject's face
Check that the script text is easily readable
Verify the horizontal band creates a clear focal point
Confirm the color palette feels unified
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, mixed-media portrait with a bold horizontal typographic anchor and a secondary script accent to create a vintage-inspired music aesthetic.
